source_authority.semantics: SWRD=1 actual and potential root depth are recalculated as min(AFGEN(RDTB,DVS),RDM); no independent root-depth continuation state.

ownership.root_depth: derived read-only geometry from committed crop DVS and immutable RDTB/RDM
ownership.root_profile: ephemeral typed materialization from root depth, soil compartment bottoms and immutable relative density table
ownership.restart_implication: none; DVS remains owned and persisted by the existing crop owner

checks: SWRD1 AFGEN interpolation, endpoint clamping and RDM clipping at O0/O2
B1.11-style static root-profile materialization at O0/O2
production Reference ET -> typed crop root input -> existing root uptake chain at O0/O2
sink total equals potential transpiration in unstressed fixture; no second mass owner
inactive/persistent-state semantics inherited because resolver and profile are stateless

preservation: existing WOFOST and WOFOST81 crop owners remain distinct and unchanged except a read-only derived method on the common owner
root frost, salinity and MICRO routes not reopened or modified
claim_ceiling: Only SWRD=1 DVS-table root depth plus static profile production binding. Does not admit SWRD2 growth/history, SWRD3 biomass depth, adaptive root density, oxygen growth suppression, constant absolute LRV, sowing, rotation, fixed crop or other WOFOST selectors.
